evals.prompt: Audit every architecture and process diagram in the Agentweaver docs, consolidate duplicates, and prepare the retained concepts for a complete visual revamp.
evals.expected_output: A GPT-6 Astra-orchestrated docs-only audit with complete inventory, concept dispositions, canonical consolidation, downstream pitch/iterate work, integrity checks, JSON report, and human summary.
expectations: Repository implementation and current written docs are treated as ground truth.
Existing diagrams are treated as legacy assessment inputs only.
Every diagram source, PNG, hash, and Markdown reference is inventoried.
Every concept is classified retain, reuse, merge, remove, or redesign.
Every surviving concept invokes docs-diagram-pitch and docs-diagram-iterate using GPT-6 Astra.
Stable paths are preserved unless consolidation records an intentional change.
Final validation rejects orphaned artifacts and broken links.
Both machine-readable and human-readable reports are emitted.

evals.prompt: This docs rewrite removes an architecture section and adds a new process description. Check whether the repository's diagrams need to change.
evals.expected_output: The audit skill is considered because the docs change can invalidate, remove, or introduce architectural/process visuals.
expectations: The trigger covers documentation changes with indirect diagram impact.

evals.prompt: Fix one overlapping arrow in docs/diagrams/src/coordinator.drawio.
evals.expected_output: The repo-wide audit skill should defer to docs-diagram-iterate for a single routine diagram correction.
expectations: The trigger description excludes one-diagram routine fixes.

evals.prompt: Change the coordinator topology behavior in the web application.
evals.expected_output: The docs-diagram-audit skill should not trigger because shipped product behavior is outside its docs-only scope.
expectations: The skill explicitly excludes product surface and runtime changes.
